reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Lacto Soy Mild Peeling Bubble Cleaser 180ml
reviews.text: The texture on the skin is delicious. It forms a creamy and very light foam. After using the skin is left with a soft texture.
reviews.zh: 上皮膚嘅質感一流。形成creamy而好輕盈嘅泡。用完之後皮膚留低柔軟嘅質感。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Lacto Soy Mild Peeling Bubble Cleaser 180ml
reviews.text:
濡れた肌に塗り伸ばして少し放置したら、うっすらと粗めに発泡してきました。
ピーリング力は名前の通りマイルドそうで使いやすい。あと１回であきらかに透明感でる！明るくなる！
ただし、ポンプの先に泡が出てきます。これはこういうアイテムの宿命なんてすね。
reviews.zh:
搽勻喺濕咗嘅皮膚上，等一陣之後，開始有少少粗嘅泡沫出現。
磨砂嘅力度同個名一樣，感覺好溫和易用。用一次就明顯有透明感！皮膚變得光亮！
不過，泵口會出泡，呢種嘢應該就係呢類產品嘅宿命啦。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Lacto Soy Mild Peeling Bubble Cleaser 180ml
reviews.text: This is a nice cleanser and I love using it as a mask. It works really well with the cleansing oil from this line. I would repurchase!
reviews.zh: 呢款潔面產品好好，我鍾意當面膜用。佢同呢個系列嘅卸妝油一齊用效果好好。我會再回購！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Lacto Soy Mild Peeling Bubble Cleaser 180ml
reviews.text: Eu amei esse produto. A textura na pele é deliciosa. Forma uma espuma cremosa e bem leve. Depois de usar a pele fica com uma textura macia.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢件產品。搽上皮膚嘅質地好正。形成嘅泡沫好creamy又好輕。用完之後皮膚變得好柔軟。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Lacto Soy Mild Peeling Bubble Cleaser 180ml
reviews.text: The foam wash starts out milk gel like consistency. Once completely applied it starts to activate as you rub around the face. It gets pretty foamy and rinse off smooth. No tacky consistency
reviews.zh: 呢款泡沫潔面一開始係好似乳液gel嘅質地。完全搽勻之後，喺面上打圈就會開始啟動。泡沫變得好豐富，沖完之後好滑。冇黏笠嘅感覺。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Lacto Soy Mild Peeling Bubble Cleaser 180ml
reviews.text: I get such a clean feeling after I use this bubble cleanser and my sensitive skin loves it! Just perfect!
reviews.zh: 用完呢款泡泡潔面之後有種好乾淨嘅感覺，我嘅敏感肌好鍾意！完美！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Lacto Soy Mild Peeling Bubble Cleaser 180ml
reviews.text: I really like this cleanser! It softly exfoliates and has a nice foaming texture. Also doesn’t dry me out. I use this about 2-3 times per week after my oil cleanse.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款潔面！佢會溫和地去角質，仲有好好嘅泡沫質地。亦都唔會令我覺得乾。我每星期用大約2-3次，喺油性卸妝之後用。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Lacto Soy Mild Peeling Bubble Cleaser 180ml
reviews.text: I was really surprised by this cleanser. It left my skin feeling soft and it’s non stripping. Its also helps with exfoliating the skin a bit. I recommend this more for dry skin types .
reviews.zh: 我對呢款潔面真係好驚喜。用完之後皮膚變得柔軟，唔會帶走太多水分。佢亦都有少少去角質嘅作用。我會推薦俾乾性肌嘅人多啲。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
